bsfilter_path.description: Path to the bsfilter executable; defaults to 'bsfilter' (assumed in PATH)

train_ham_command.description: Command to train bsfilter with ham (non-spam) messages. Must include %f placeholder for the message file.

train_spam_command.description: Command to train bsfilter with spam messages. Must include %f placeholder for the message file.

bayesian_threshold.description: Bayesian classification threshold between 0.0 and 1.0. Messages with probability >= threshold are marked as spam.

use_custom_db_path.description: If true, use a custom path for the bsfilter database files.

custom_db_path.description: Custom path to the bsfilter database directory (used only if use_custom_db_path is true).

learn_headers.description: List of MIME headers that should be included when training. Example: ['From', 'Subject', 'X-Mailer']. Empty list means use defaults.
